faqs.question: What is customer support software, and why do UAE businesses need it?
faqs.answer:
• Customer support software helps businesses organize customer inquiries from multiple communication channels, assign them to the right team, and resolve issues faster.
  • For businesses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other emirates, customers may ask questions through WhatsApp, Instagram, email, website chat, or phone calls. Without a centralized system, agents can miss messages, repeat answers, or struggle to follow previous conversations.
  • MSG91 Hello is customer support software in the UAE that combines these channels with AI chatbots, ticket management, automation, and analytics.
  • Whether you're managing a real estate company, online store, hospitality business, or service organization, Hello provides unlimited agents without separate per-agent license fees.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello, and how does it work for UAE businesses?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello is AI customer support software in the UAE that brings customer communication, automation, and team collaboration into one platform.
  • Businesses can connect WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, website chat, email, and other channels, then invite agents to manage customer inquiries.
  • The platform allows teams to build no-code AI chatbots, configure ticket routing, assign responsibilities, and monitor performance through a centralized dashboard.
  • For example, a Dubai real estate agency can use an AI chatbot to collect property requirements, answer questions about available listings through connected data, and transfer interested buyers to an agent for follow-up.

faqs.question: Which communication channels does MSG91 Hello support in the UAE?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello helps UAE businesses manage WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, X (Twitter), and configured calling services in one shared inbox. Apple Messages for Business can be added where provisioned.
  • Every conversation can be organized into a ticket with the customer's previous messages, notes, and assigned team member.
  • For example, a hotel in Abu Dhabi may receive booking inquiries through its website, airport-transfer questions on WhatsApp, and feedback through Instagram.
  • Instead of checking three different applications, the hospitality team can manage connected conversations through Hello.
